title: Homecoming Week
intro: Discharge is not the finish line. Give days 0–7 the same specificity as the night treatment begins: named people, named places, and named times. Privileges unlock on a plan—not in the driveway.
privacy: Private on this device · Not shared with treatment or housing providers by default
loading: Opening your protected Homecoming Week plan…
loadErrorTitle: Protected Homecoming Week data could not be opened
loadErrorBody: Editing is blocked so unread data cannot be replaced by a blank plan. Retry, or deliberately erase this device's Homecoming Week plan and start over.
clearBody: This permanently removes this account's protected Homecoming Week details from this device.
saveError: Protected save failed. This plan cannot turn green until every change is saved.
readyTitle: Homecoming Week is ready and saved
notReadyTitle: Do not treat discharge as an unplanned return
readyBody: The discharge plan and all applicable day 0–7 handoffs are specific and protected on this device.
notReadyBody: Identity, discharge instructions, housing, meetings, aftercare, and every applicable week item must be specific and safely saved before this turns green.
dischargeMissing: Discharge plan still has {{count}} required field(s) missing or blocked.
sectionRecovery: 6 · Meetings, work or school, and aftercare
requiredHint: Required before any week item can turn green.

identity.exactAge: Exact age (optional when age control is selected)
identity.gender: Gender for optional housing and meeting fit only
identity.genderRule: Gender never decides who holds keys, money, the phone, or household responsibilities.

fit.youth_woman: Youth fit: require a named receiving adult and supervised first weekend. Girls' or young-people meetings may be useful options when available.
fit.youth_man: Youth fit: require a named receiving adult and supervised first weekend. Boys' or young-people meetings may be useful options when available.
fit.youth_nonbinary: Youth fit: require a named receiving adult and supervised first weekend. Look for affirming youth housing and meeting options when useful.
fit.youth_neutral: Youth fit: require a named receiving adult, a supervised first weekend, and no unsupervised return to using friends.
fit.young_adult_woman: Young-adult fit: women-specific sober living and women's or young-people meetings are optional fits—not moral rules. Parents' home is still excluded unless treatment wrote it.
fit.young_adult_man: Young-adult fit: men-specific sober living and men's or young-people meetings are optional fits—not moral rules. Parents' home is still excluded unless treatment wrote it.
fit.young_adult_nonbinary: Young-adult fit: affirming sober living and inclusive or young-people meetings are optional fits. Parents' home is still excluded unless treatment wrote it.
fit.young_adult_neutral: Young-adult fit: compare sober-living and young-people meeting options without assuming a return to parents. Use only the housing named by treatment.
fit.adult_woman: Adult fit: women-specific housing or meetings may be useful options. Protect outpatient and return-to-work timing; do not default to parents' home.
fit.adult_man: Adult fit: men-specific housing or meetings may be useful options. Protect outpatient and return-to-work timing; do not default to parents' home.
fit.adult_nonbinary: Adult fit: affirming housing and inclusive meetings may be useful options. Protect outpatient and work timing; do not default to parents' home.
fit.adult_neutral: Adult fit: use the housing, outpatient, meeting, and work plan written at discharge. Do not default to parents' home.

discharge.housingType: Next living situation written on the discharge plan
discharge.housingDetails: Named place, address/city, and first-night details
discharge.housingPlaceholder: Use the actual discharge destination—not a family wish
discharge.receivingAdult: Receiving parent, guardian, or named adult
discharge.adultControl: Treatment discharge paperwork specifically says this adult returns to the family / parents' home
discharge.adultControlHint: Off by default. Turn this on only when the discharge document names that destination.
discharge.adultQuote: Quote the discharge language that names parents' / family home
discharge.adultBlock: For adults, going back to parents is only in this plan if treatment wrote it on the discharge plan. Confirm that control and quote the language, or use the sober-living / other discharge housing actually named.
discharge.soberRules: Curfew and house rules the family was told
discharge.outpatientTransport: Named driver or exact transportation plan, plus backup
discharge.meetingsKnown: Are actual meeting times and places known?
discharge.firstMeetings: Home group or first meetings: days and times
discharge.backupMeeting: One backup meeting: day, time, and place/link
discharge.employmentStatus: Employment or education plan as written
discharge.employmentHelper: Named person helping with work / school plan
discharge.aftercareStatus: Was an aftercare clinician or alumni contact named?
discharge.medicationRule: Do not enter doses, DEA numbers, prescription numbers, or full medication details.
discharge.otherPlaceholder: Instructions from the paperwork only; this cannot bypass the adult housing rule

itemFields.naReason: Why this truly does not apply

day0_pickup.title: Pickup and first destination
day0_pickup.body: Name the pickup person, backup, and where they go that night. The destination must match the adult/minor housing rule.
day0_pickup.details: Pickup route and direct first destination

day0_access.title: Phone, keys, cards, and cash for 24 hours
day0_access.body: Name who holds each item and what is directly paid. Do not hand back the old system in the driveway.
day0_access.details: Phone, car keys, cards, cash, and direct-payment plan

day0_first_night.title: First-night structure
day0_first_night.body: Name who is present, lights-out time, and the exact response if they want to stop by a friend's.
day0_first_night.details: Who is present, lights out, and the no-friend-stop response

family_session.title: Family session booked before day 3
family_session.body: FamilyBridge, coaching, Al-Anon, or a therapist: a family session, not a lecture. Name the time and how to join.
family_session.details: Session, facilitator, joining instructions, and purpose

outpatient_calendar.title: First outpatient appointment on the calendar
outpatient_calendar.body: Use the actual PHP / IOP / outpatient discharge plan. Name transportation and backup.

meetings_calendar.title: First fellowship meetings on the calendar
meetings_calendar.body: Not “they should go to AA.” Use actual days, times, places or links, and a backup meeting.

irritability_sentence.title: Irritable-versus-using sentence practiced once
irritability_sentence.body: Irritability is not relapse; using is. Write what the family will do in each case without a fight.

days1_3_privileges.title: No new privileges for days 1–3
days1_3_privileges.body: Car, overnight guests, and “just this once” money stay closed unless the discharge plan explicitly unlocks them.
days1_3_privileges.details: Closed privileges and who holds the line

first_weekend.title: First weekend written in advance
first_weekend.body: Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday: where, with whom, meetings, and what is not happening—bars, using friends, or unsupervised parties.
first_weekend.details: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, meetings, people, and exclusions

privilege_schedule.title: Privilege schedule
privilege_schedule.body: List phone, car, cash, overnight, and visitors with the earliest unlock day and the named decision-maker.

employment_school.title: Employment or school first contact
employment_school.body: Only when the discharge plan includes it. Do not push work that conflicts with PHP / IOP.
employment_school.details: First contact date and how treatment schedule stays protected

day7_review.title: Day 7 private, no-shame review
day7_review.body: Record what held, what slipped, and what stays locked next week. Treat a slip as information, not humiliation.
day7_review.details: What held, what slipped, and next week's locked privileges

safety.emergencyTitle: Emergency care is never gated by this plan
safety.emergencyBody: For overdose, immediate danger, severe withdrawal, violence, or another life-threatening emergency, call 911 now.
safety.crisisBody: Call or text 988. Do not wait for Homecoming Week to be complete.
safety.helpTitle: If they ask for help now, act now
safety.helpBody: Do not delay immediate voluntary help because this plan is incomplete. Contact the discharge program, clinician, or appropriate care now and complete logistics alongside the handoff.

footer: No surveillance. No sponsored rankings. No paid placement. No invented outcomes. A professional off-ramp is support—not a sales condition.
